description: This file defines and exports functions to fetch project-related financial data from a backend API. It includes methods for retrieving project cost details and cost history sums via GET requests to specific API endpoints.

methods.name: getProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost for a specific project by projectId. Calls GET /api/projects/:projectId/cost and processes the response to return projectId, cost, and currency.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the total cost sum for a project from cost history data, considering granular deltas. Calls GET /api/projects/:projectId/cost-history-sum and processes the response to return projectId and cost.
